events.title: Watch Roy_Lovat's In Depth Review of The Last Admiral
events.summary: Roy_Lovat just posted an in depth review of The Last Admiral. If you want to see how a run plays before you jump in, it's a great watch. https://youtu.be/chZimAadcJw Thanks for the video, Roy! The free demo is out now during Steam Next Fest, and a wishlist is the best way to hear the moment the full game launches.

events.title: Update v0.8.5: A Fairer Opening, Better Loot and Living Towns
events.summary: Map changes apply to new expeditions. New Sector 1: the story arc has been refined. Defense battles rebuilt: the station stands at the centre, your fleet warps in around it, and each new wave arrives one round after its warning, away from your ships. Forced Engagement: a FLEET COMMAND button lets you repair and refit before the fight. Starter fleets: Roguelike Endless can start with any faction whose crest you have earned (Allies always). A crest needs all of that faction's pilot portraits; Reap

events.title: Update v0.8.4 - Admiral Vance, the Salvage Race and Your Own XO
events.summary: Sector 1 now has a story thread and a rival who talks back, Salvage battles are a race, your XO gets a name and a face, and every new map spreads its battles more evenly. Fleet Command, Fabricate, Upgrade and Equip get a round of improvements too, along with many battle fixes. Map and story changes apply to new expeditions and newly generated maps; an expedition already under way keeps the map it has. Story details below are hidden as spoilers. New Admiral Vance. events.title: Demo v0.8.3 - Sector 1 Pacing, Shared Trade Post Stock and Fleet Details
events.summary: This patch reworks how Sector 1 ramps up, makes every Trade Post share one stock, and gives Fleet Command and Inspect much more detail, along with a round of battle and interface fixes. In the full game, enemy Energy Lance outposts now threaten your systems from Sector 3 on. It also covers v0.8.2, which went out without notes; its two changes are marked (v0.8.2). events.title: Demo v0.8.1 - Shorter Sectors, Clear Capture Targets and Battle Fixes
events.summary: A day after v0.8.0, this patch tightens the campaign and fixes what playtesting turned up. Sector 1 is shorter and pays more along the way, targets you are meant to capture now stand out, reward cards get shortcut buttons, the Wraith hunt isolated ships, and a long list of battle fixes lands, from spread weapons to the final kill. New Shortcuts on the rewards screen. Reward cards now offer the next step: BUILD NOW on a surveyed building site lets you build there right away, TRADE SHOP NOW on a c

events.title: Demo v0.8.0 - Vance Strikes Back, Roguelike Endless and Five New Languages
events.summary: One week of work since v0.7.0. The demo finale is reworked into Vance Strikes Back, Roguelike Endless is now playable in the demo, and five new languages bring the game to fifteen. Enemy fleets fight smarter, battles move faster, your shots land where you click, planets carry faction towns and ruins, combat rewards are reworked, and menus and the battle HUD have a new forged metal look. New Vance Strikes Back. The demo's last battle, at the halfway point of Sector 1, is now Admiral Vance's Allia

events.title: Demo v0.7.0 - Every Faction Playable, Module Power and Deployables
events.summary: Two weeks of work since v0.6.2. Every faction in the game can now fly in your fleet, modules draw from each hull's power budget, a whole family of deployable modules lands on the board, every planet now changes the battle, and far more of the game is translated in all ten languages. New Every faction joins your fleet. Hive, Pirates, Sehn, Ancients, the Lava Dragon, Storm Dragon, Forest Dragon, Crystal Dragon and Obsidian Dragon, and the Reapers can now fly for you alongside the Allies, Enlighten

events.title: Demo v0.6.2 - Range Ring Fix, Engine Hits on Every Ship, and Menu Polish
events.summary: These notes cover v0.6.1 as well, a quick fix that went out without notes of its own. Changed Engine hits on every ship. Striking any ship from behind now earns the engine-hit bonus, drones and escort transports included. Only Starbases, structures and orbital weapons are exempt, and a Capital planted by Bulwark no longer shrugs engine hits off. Engine plumes. Plumes now run about the same length on every ship, and several hulls got cleaner plume widths. Equip. Hovering a loadout slot waits for

events.title: Demo v0.6.0 - Hold Turn, 18 New Perks, Hull-Shaped Hitboxes, and a New Look
events.summary: Two weeks of work since v0.5.1, and plenty of it came straight from player reports on the demo. Ships can now hold their turn, perks and Commander upgrades got bigger and more specific, every hull collides and blocks shots with its real shape, drones and objectives were reworked, and most screens in the game have a new look. events.title: Demo v0.5.0 - Signature Abilities, a New Tutorial, and an Original Soundtrack
events.summary: The biggest update since the demo launched. Every hull in the game learned to do something of its own, the tutorial was rebuilt from scratch, and the soundtrack is now original music written for the game. New Every hull has a signature ability. More than 80 of them, one per hull per faction, so a Vanguard Titan and a Wraith Titan no longer fight the same way. events.title: Demo Update v0.4.1
events.summary: Changed The flagship lesson now circles the whole ship, its health bars and its badge together, and the badge blinks with a gold ring until you close the card. Implosion weapons collapse inward with a sharper snap, and the coolant purge swirls wider. Beams fade into their own glow instead of stopping at a flat edge, and burst weapons flash at the muzzle for every shot. Enemy fleets fit their roles better: armored hulls protect the layers they actually have, and carriers bring drones instead of e

events.title: v0.4.0 - Guided first battle, Endless after Sector 1, freeze fixes
events.summary: A real first hour A scripted guided first battle. Your first fight teaches moving, aiming, firing and mining on a board built for the lesson, and the pirates take their turn too. Progressive onboarding. The interface arrives one piece at a time: Fleet Command opens after your second warp, and each lesson opens on the ship it is about. One tip per moment. The first sortie comes with a checklist, and the menu opens on one clear door. Endless, sooner Endless mode unlocks the moment you clear Sector

events.title: v0.3.1 - Fortress rework, salvage drones, asteroid retune
events.summary: Combat Fortress objectives are one target again. A fortress node used to stage a duplicate base prop wearing the same art, so the thing you had to kill sat beside a decoy that looked just like it. Contested installations are sized properly. The Fortress in particular is much larger now, which makes it easier to hit and much better cover to fight around. Nothing resolves before the shot that caused it lands. events.title: v0.3.0 - objective briefings, wipe pushback, storms, Trade Post rebuild, faster
events.summary: The Last Admiral Demo v0.3.0NEW- Mission briefings. Every objective battle opens with a camera sweep over what you came for, and your XO explains the objective the first time you meet it.- Losing your fleet no longer always ends the run. Past 25% completion the enemy takes the deepest quarter of your territory instead, your buildings stay on their slots (dark until you retake them), and your fleet is rebuilt in place. events.title: Patch 0.2.9
events.summary: v0.2.9Fixed- Fresh installs on a 1920x1080 monitor no longer start in fullscreen at the wrong resolution. A 0.2.8 mistake: the Windows taskbar was being subtracted from the screen size, so 1080p looked too small for its own default.- Steam Deck controllers now work. The game was handing input to Steam Input even when no bindings had loaded, which left the pad unresponsive.- An enemy turn can no longer hang forever.
